artworks.title: faces

artworks.alt: Performance. The artist turns the venue into a spaceship that he navigates with a futuristic console. The universe shown on the screen consists of words instead of stars or planets. He communicates with someone on the viewscreen and plays some music on a strange instrument.
artworks.title: the search
artworks.medium: performance using a custom website, video-chat, and a console made of cardboard & colored foil

artworks.alt: Composition of three videos separated by colored lines a star-shaped cursor moving across it. The three videos feature Donald Trump, Kristi Noem, and the execution of Alex Pretti by ICE (the U.S.' immigration police force) officers. The colorful interface and rhythm-tracker at the top are features of the OTAMASKETCH, an audio-visual educational tool for young patriots-in-the-making using the Otamatone (a Japanese musical instrument in the shape of a tadpole) as an interface to shape, reveal, and conceal video archives.
artworks.title: ☆OTAMASKETCH☆
